text:
aya: Heads up — brought up redwood-draft-13b-q4 on canary for throughput tests. Speed gains look good (~1.6x tokens/sec) but a regression shows up on entity preservation for NER-heavy prompts (~4% micro-F1 drop).

tom: Thanks Aya. Short checklist: deterministic eval (temp=0), per-token argmax concordance, KL between logits, and hidden-state L2 per layer. Did you run any of those yet?

aya: Ran argmax concordance quick-pass: avg 92% vs fp16 on dev-ner; mismatches concentrated on proper nouns and numeric tokens.

rachel: Numeric tokens often get mapped to different subword splits after quant kernels change softmax. Can you dump tokenization diffs?

aya: Will do. Also planning two ablations: (A) small logit scaling factor (1.01/1.02) before softmax; (B) draft-stage fp16 KV/cache fallback to isolate quant compute.

tom: Add another control: rerun q4 but with bias-corrected weights bucket (we have calibration table from prior runs). Might fix systematic logit bias.

rachel: Eval protocol proposal: three seeds (1/42/2026), datasets: ner-ctl, summarize-named, numeric-extract; metrics: NER micro-F1, token argmax match, mean logit KL, S-BERT for semantics. Include 200 sampled diffs for human spot-check.

aya: I'll run A/B for logit-scale (1.00,1.01,1.02), and kv-fallback control. ETA ~90m.

tom: If logit-scaling closes gap without hurting fluency, we can add a small per-route multiplier in runtime. But check edge cases where scaling increases overconfidence and hallucination.

rachel: Also track prefix-length dependency (<50,50-200,>200) and entity-density buckets. If short prefixes are worse, it suggests tokenization or early attention drift.

devbot: canary deploy scheduled: redwood-draft-13b-q4 -> eng-ml-canary at 2026-05-02T09:00:00Z (label: draft13b-q4-6876).

aya: Posting quick sample diff here:
```
PROMPT: "AcmeCorp announced on 2025-11-10 that their revenue hit $12.5M ..."
FP16: "AcmeCorp reported $12.5M in revenue on Nov 10, 2025."
Q4:   "The company reported revenue and gave a date."
```

rachel: That's the pattern — loss of numeric specificity and named-entity tokens. Good to capture tokenization alignment and argmax mismatch positions.

tom: I'll stand up a small viz script to aggregate argmax mismatch by token type and give per-layer L2 heatmap. Ping when CSVs are ready.

aya: Will upload outputs and sample diffs in this thread when done. If scaling helps, we can push a conservative 1.01 multiplier and monitor.

rachel: If scaling fixes but creates overconfidence on other routes, consider a per-route multiplier (ner routes only).

aya: Agreed. Followups: I'll run calibration dumps + logit-scale ablations and post results in ~90m.

devbot: telemetry flag enabled: quant.calibration_dump=true for canary run draft13b-q4-6876.
